page.layout: One printed page. Full-width ornamental headpiece at top; below it the dedication text in one column of full-width lines. A bracketed group of names at upper left has a bracket note at right ("Illustr. Reip. San-Gallensis..."), and a second bracket note at right beside the Hoeggero lines ("Agnatis suis ad aras usq; venerandis"). Catchword-like word "NEC" at lower right, set apart. Faint show-through text in the lower centre is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Magnificentissimis, Amplissimis, Consultissimis, ac Gravissimis Viris
main_text.p: Dn. JOH. JOACHIMO HALTMEJERO, Illustr. Reip. San-Gallensis Consulibus Prudentissimis, Dn. Mœcenatibus ac Fautoribus meis summâ observantiâ omni tempore colendis.

Dn. TOBIÆ SCHOBINGERO, Senatûs quotidiani Assessori Nobilissimo, Ærarij Ecclesiastici Administratori fidissimo, Quæsturâ quondam ad Patriæ bonum summâ cum laude defuncto, Patrono suo nunquam non honorando.
Dn. CASPARO CUNTZIO, Senatori meritissimo, Quæstori conscientiosissimo.
Dn. GEORGIO HOEGGERO, Senatori dignissimo, Capitaneo Urbico strenuissimo.
Dn. SEBASTIANO HOEGGERO, recens electo Senatori prudentissimo, suo è Sacro baptismatis fonte susceptori. Agnatis suis ad aras usq; venerandis.
CÆTERISQUE EJUSDEM REIPUBLICÆ PROCERIBUS, PROCONSULIBUS, SENATORIBUS &c. Patribus Patriæ. Mœcenatibus suis omni obsequiorum & honoris cultu devenerandis.

page.notes: The bracket note at upper right and the bracket note beside the Hoeggero lines are marginal; the Hoeggero note is placed at its line. Names in the first group are set with the bracket and transcribed as separate lines. The word "NEC" at lower right is a catchword-like fragment. Faint show-through in the lower centre is omitted.
